events.title: YSC Annual Parish Sports Day 2026
events.description: Annual sports and fellowship tournament bringing together all Blessed Sacrament Parish youth and families at Mukuru Grounds. Competitions in football, volleyball, athletics, and cultural dances.

events.title: Parish Pastoral Council General Assembly
events.description: Quarterly consultative assembly of Blessed Sacrament parish executive leaders, SCC representatives, and apostolic groups to evaluate pastoral initiatives and parish calendar.

events.title: Solemnity of Corpus Christi Parish Vigil
events.description: Overnight Eucharistic Adoration, vigil prayers, and solemn choral benediction culminating in the dawn Eucharistic procession through Buru-Phase III streets.

events.title: CMA Men Fellowship & Mentorship Breakfast
events.description: Catholic Men Association spiritual reflection, breakfast, and youth mentorship outreach session.
